| `MainOptions` | Interface | Options a carrier's bin shim passes to `main`. `distribution` names the package the `effected` bin was installed through; omitted for a direct install of `@effected/cli`. | from `@effected/cli/main` |

| `rootCommand` | Variable | The `effected` command tree.
